ai:config.active_model_name_comment: Define the active model name here. This is the model that will be used to generate the report.

ai_debug.ai_debug_comment: Each AI response will be stored in the ai_debug/ directory. This is useful for debugging and testing.

nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free_o.comment: This is a very good chat model for local usage with a great context window and very good performance. But it is not the best for more complex tasks
nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free_o.response_format_comment: Optional for OpenRouter /chat/completions: use response_format like {"type":"json_object"} for valid JSON or {"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{...}} for strict schema output.

prompts_and_templates.comment: Prompts and tempates are connented to eachother. The prompt is used to generate the template and the template is used to generate the report.
